newsitem.title: USA: A & A Foods says court found it in violation.
newsitem.headline: A & A Foods says court found it in violation.

text.p: A & A Foods Ltd said the provincial court of British Columbia has found that it contravened the labelling and sale provisions of Canada's Food and Drug Law.
In a statement, the Port Coquitlam, British Columbia-based company said it was also found to have possessed unlabeled cheese, in violation of Canada's dairy product regulations.
It said its president, Giovanni Camporese, was found to have contravened Section 71(2) of those regulations under Canada's Agricultural Products Act.
The company said sentencing has been scheduled for April 17.
It said lawyers representing the company and Camporese are currently reviewing the reasons for the judgment.
